summary: Type Forward's microsite for Garet, a geometric sans (variable wght 50–950 plus italic), built on a visible hairline grid where empty cells are labelled with their area in px². Each section is a different toy: sliding style-labelled wordmarks, a Bézier editor for the alternate g, a per-word tester driven by mouse gestures, a microphone-driven weight demo and a magnifier over the glyph map. A cookie-consent modal covers the centre of every capture, so much of this is read from the HTML.

Buy↗' and white 'Free download · Two free weights'. Mostly hidden by the cookie modal in the capture

instances.variantDefinition: One glyph drawn as its outline with on-curve points and Bézier handles that the visitor drags to reshape it, with undo/redo, a rewind to the original and an image download: the glyph's construction becomes a toy.
instances.look: 'Mess with the g' at left with two lines of copy and a keyboard legend (Ctrl+Z Undo, Ctrl+Y Redo, Right Click Toggle Shape Outlines); at right a huge black alternate double-storey 'g' on a canvas, its outline traced in red with square on-curve points and round handles; Download and ↻ Rewind buttons in a black strip under the text
instances.ux: Select any point and drag it or its handles to deform the g; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo; right-click toggles the outline view; Rewind animates back to the original; Download exports the result as an image with a transparent or solid background (desktop); mobile gets a simpler 'Hide outlines' toggle
instances.learn: Let visitors grab the real Bézier points of the most characterful glyph: they feel how carefully the original is drawn when they break it, and they leave with an image

instances.look: 'Experience Garet' with a gesture legend (Scroll = Font Size, Hold Left = Font Weight, Hold Right = Italic Angle, Spacebar = Letter-spacing); below, a framed editor: black Reset and Set buttons around a 'Type here…' field and a theme toggle, a narrow left column of OpenType samples (fi, ty, aa, вв, 1a, [], 11, A₂, A², ½, 0, ligature X; active one in red), and a large paragraph of mixed Latin/Cyrillic words, numerals, symbols and dingbats (☞ ❺ ⚐ →) at ~58px light weight, each word styleable on its own
instances.ux: Hover a word, then scroll to resize it, hold the left button to sweep its weight, hold the right button to slant it, press space to track it out; click a feature cell to apply that OpenType feature; type a new text and press Set (resets all styling); Reset restores the sample; mobile swaps gestures for Weight 50–950, Italic 0–100 and Size 57–384 sliders on the selected word
instances.learn: Map axes to mouse gestures on individual words: visitors style a paragraph word by word and discover the range without a single slider

instances.variantDefinition: The microphone's input level drives a variable axis (usually weight) of a large word or of its individual letters in real time; the visitor's voice or ambient noise is the only control.
instances.look: 'Sound=weight' with a line asking for microphone access and an orange 'We are not recording or storing any data.'; a black panel with a big white microphone button at top right; below, the word 'talk' set huge (~360px) in a hairline weight
instances.ux: Press the mic button and allow the microphone; speaking or making noise thickens the letters of 'talk' (per character), silence thins them back
instances.learn: Use the visitor's voice as the axis controller: the word 'talk' invites the action, and loudness → weight is instantly understood
